body: Filed 2026-09-25 from PR #233 measured test time: after the in-tree move, internal/tasks/authority dominates both measured runs (544 s and 655 s) and now sits in the Core go test ./... gate. Profile the package and cut the dominant cost without weakening assertions.
title: internal/tasks/authority tests take 544-655 s
